Types

The shape of the objects you pass in.

GameOptions

GameOptions

The options of createGame (and of new Game(options)). Everything has a default, so pass only what you need.

OptionTypeDefaultMeaning
roomsArray.<(Object|string)> | Object[]Room objects, or URLs of room JSON files (pictures named in a room file load relative to it). A list, or an object { id: room }.
stringsObject.<string, string>{}Text keys and their text. The built-in answers ("I can't use that.") are already included.
itemsObject{}Inventory items: { key: 'brass key' }, or { key: { text: 'brass key', image: 'key.png' } }.
recipesArray.<Object>[]Items that combine: [{ a: 'stick', b: 'string', result: 'pole' }]. Each recipe can also have say (a text key for the hero to say) and consume (which of a and b are used up).
soundsObject.<string, string>{}Sound id to file: { theme: 'theme.ogg', click: 'click.wav' }. A room's music field plays one.
sfxObject.<string, string>{}Sounds for events: { 'inventory:add': 'pickup' }.
widthnumber640The game's fixed width. The canvas is scaled to fit, never stretched.
heightnumber360The game's fixed height.
heroObject{}The hero's options: speed (150), directions (4 or 8), animations.
mode'smart' | 'verbs''smart''verbs' gives a verb list (Look at / Use / Walk to).
fadeMsnumber300Length of the fade between rooms, in milliseconds.
followHerobooleantrueIn rooms wider than the screen, the camera follows the hero.
debugKeystring | null'd'The key that toggles the outlines of hotspots and floors. null turns it off.
languagestring'en'The language of strings.
saveSlotstring'game'Where Game#save and Game#load keep the game.
storageObjectWhere saves and settings go (default: localStorage).
Storyfunctioninkjs's Story class, if you import inkjs instead of loading ink.js with a script tag.
parentHTMLElement | stringAn element (or its id) to put the game in. The game fills it. Default: the page.
fitbooleantrueScale the canvas to fill its parent, with letterbox bars. false leaves it at its size.
canvasbooleantruefalse uses a canvas you created yourself.
